sentences.sentence: Have you ever been proud of yourself for something you did?
This was a challenge because the test would be in one week.
I felt really worried because I was not ready.
I decided to study with my best friend.
I started to feel better because we helped each other learn everything.
I think that we got good scores because we studied everything together.
I learned that if I work hard, I can be successful.
I was very proud that we helped each other do well on the test.
